records.name: Angelica Michelle
records.hero_grammar: Salon brand hero uses people/service atmosphere to create aspirational but approachable trust.
records.media_strategy_crop_negative_space: Real salon/beauty media carries identity and service expectation.
records.typography_hierarchy: Fashion/editorial display hierarchy with practical booking handoff.
records.color_topology: Beauty-forward branded palette; imagery dominates early, utility later.
records.density_whitespace_rhythm: Low-density visual opening, increasing density at menu/locations/booking.
records.module_composition_grammar: aspiration → service identity → examples/people → locations/menu → booking
records.cta_choreography: Booking remains contextual to chosen service/location.
records.trust_proof_placement: Real business locations and service context ground the aspirational front half.
records.desktop_to_mobile_transformation: Mobile should turn visual grids into intentional editorial sequences, not undifferentiated image stacks.
records.distinctive_authored_mechanisms: Multiple service/location identities are kept coherent without one generic card grammar.
records.template_like_vs_custom_signals: CUSTOM-LEANING: brand/editorial rhythm distinguishes it from commodity booking pages.

records.name: HAIR ICI
records.hero_grammar: Brand philosophy hero defines beauty through '衣食住美' and lifestyle before transactions.
records.media_strategy_crop_negative_space: Authored editorial shoots, salons, products, journal and people create a continuous cultural world.
records.typography_hierarchy: Bilingual/editorial hierarchy; labels and chapter markers behave like magazine navigation.
records.color_topology: Mostly restrained neutral fields that let photography and typography carry identity.
records.density_whitespace_rhythm: Long-form editorial breathing space alternates with dense journal/gallery clusters.
records.module_composition_grammar: philosophy → salon/product/shop ecosystem → journal → recruit/info → deeper editorial stories
records.cta_choreography: Conversion is distributed by intent (salon, shop, recruit, social), not forced into one CTA.
records.trust_proof_placement: Original editorial production, named contributors and real salon network create provenance.
records.desktop_to_mobile_transformation: Mobile must preserve magazine-like sequence and keep intent routes distinct.
records.distinctive_authored_mechanisms: Editorial content is not a blog add-on; it is the core authority mechanism.
records.template_like_vs_custom_signals: CUSTOM: highly authored ecosystem and rhythm; very low plausible skin-swap equivalence.

records.name: 本と美容室
records.hero_grammar: Hybrid concept hero makes bookstore + salon coexistence the reason to care.
records.media_strategy_crop_negative_space: People/place/books/hair imagery establishes a concrete local cultural proposition.
records.typography_hierarchy: Friendly editorial type hierarchy rather than luxury salon tropes.
records.color_topology: Warm local/material palette with varied cultural accents.
records.density_whitespace_rhythm: Story-led rhythm with space for concept, place and participation.
records.module_composition_grammar: concept → why hybrid exists → place/people → participation/service → visit
records.cta_choreography: Visit/participation follows understanding of the hybrid idea.
records.trust_proof_placement: Physical place and publishing provenance provide non-generic local proof.
records.desktop_to_mobile_transformation: Mobile should preserve the alternation of book/hair/place scenes rather than flattening them into one service feed.
records.distinctive_authored_mechanisms: A cross-category business model becomes the composition spine.
records.template_like_vs_custom_signals: CUSTOM: category hybrid makes generic salon-template resemblance unlikely.

records.name: 久留米のピラティススタジオ BLUE PEARL
records.hero_grammar: Pilates studio hero uses calm body/space cues to lower entry anxiety.
records.media_strategy_crop_negative_space: Studio and movement media should carry real visit context and sensory confidence.
records.typography_hierarchy: Soft approachable hierarchy with clear class/visit utility.
records.color_topology: Calm wellness palette; low visual noise supports bodily ease.
records.density_whitespace_rhythm: Low-to-medium density with practical peaks around program/access/booking.
records.module_composition_grammar: desired state → studio experience → program/fit → instructor/access → trial/booking
records.cta_choreography: Trial/visit CTA is the natural commitment step.
records.trust_proof_placement: Real space/instructor/access information is more persuasive than generic wellness claims.
records.desktop_to_mobile_transformation: Mobile should keep trial booking and access close while preserving room/movement atmosphere.
records.distinctive_authored_mechanisms: Visit confidence is treated as part of the wellness promise.
records.template_like_vs_custom_signals: CUSTOM-LEANING where real place and local next-event drive the page.

records.name: NUSET
records.hero_grammar: Dermatologist-developed skincare authority is foregrounded without visually aggressive clinicalization.
records.media_strategy_crop_negative_space: Product/skin/detail media supports expert formulation and use context.
records.typography_hierarchy: Quiet brand headings transition into precise ingredient/product information.
records.color_topology: Neutral clean base with restrained clinical/material accents.
records.density_whitespace_rhythm: Calm spacing with denser evidence around formulation and product selection.
records.module_composition_grammar: expert premise → skin problem/approach → formulation/products → use → purchase
records.cta_choreography: Purchase follows explanation of expert basis and product role.
records.trust_proof_placement: Dermatology provenance and formulation rationale are the trust center.
records.desktop_to_mobile_transformation: Mobile should preserve expert→product causality and avoid turning evidence into tiny cards.
records.distinctive_authored_mechanisms: Medical expertise is translated into calm consumer choice rather than fear.
records.template_like_vs_custom_signals: CUSTOM-LEANING: authority logic specific to expert-developed skincare.

records.name: TrueKind
records.hero_grammar: Clean-conscious proposition balances efficacy with kindness/planet positioning.
records.media_strategy_crop_negative_space: Product and ingredient imagery supports proof while material/earth cues support values.
records.typography_hierarchy: Minimal product hierarchy with clear claim/evidence handoffs.
records.color_topology: Natural restrained palette; color reinforces ingredient/material story.
records.density_whitespace_rhythm: Measured density with alternating efficacy and values proof.
records.cta_choreography: Commerce follows both efficacy and values justification.
records.trust_proof_placement: Clinical/clean claims and brand values are presented as dual trust dimensions.
records.desktop_to_mobile_transformation: Mobile should preserve the two-authority structure rather than merging everything into generic 'clean beauty'.
records.distinctive_authored_mechanisms: Efficacy and ethics are intentionally braided.
records.template_like_vs_custom_signals: CUSTOM-LEANING; generic clean-beauty styling alone would not reproduce the proof structure.

records.name: LIPPS
records.hero_grammar: Hair/fashion authority hero behaves like a culture brand before service discovery.
records.media_strategy_crop_negative_space: Editorial hair imagery and people drive aspiration; locations/services ground it.
records.typography_hierarchy: Bold fashion/editorial display type with utility hierarchy for salon navigation.
records.color_topology: High-contrast fashion palette with strong image fields.
records.density_whitespace_rhythm: Visual density varies sharply: immersive editorial scenes then practical service information.
records.cta_choreography: Intent-routed actions prevent one universal booking CTA from dominating.
records.trust_proof_placement: Real salons, stylists and established brand ecosystem supply proof.
records.desktop_to_mobile_transformation: Mobile should prioritize image sequence and location/service routing without shrinking desktop grids.
records.distinctive_authored_mechanisms: Salon authority extends across culture, product and people ecosystem.
records.template_like_vs_custom_signals: CUSTOM: brand ecosystem and image rhythm resist template substitution.

records.name: SpoiledChild
records.hero_grammar: Personalized/intelligent beauty proposition makes recommendation logic part of the hero promise.
records.media_strategy_crop_negative_space: Product imagery is paired with personalization/diagnostic cues rather than simple catalog display.
records.typography_hierarchy: Bold consumer-tech hierarchy with concise decision text.
records.color_topology: High-energy branded color system supports personalization states.
records.density_whitespace_rhythm: Fast rhythm with repeated choice/result/product beats.
records.cta_choreography: CTA is tied to entering the personalization flow.
records.trust_proof_placement: Recommendation logic and product/result context act as trust evidence.
records.desktop_to_mobile_transformation: Mobile should foreground the interactive decision path before catalog breadth.
records.distinctive_authored_mechanisms: Personalization is a conversion mechanism, not a badge.
records.template_like_vs_custom_signals: CUSTOM-LEANING: same-family pages can differ strongly depending on selector choreography.

records.name: natureofthings
records.hero_grammar: Wellness-house hero frames ritual and state change before individual SKUs.
records.media_strategy_crop_negative_space: Material, botanical and ritual imagery carries texture and sensory expectation.
records.typography_hierarchy: Quiet editorial hierarchy with product information entering later.
records.density_whitespace_rhythm: Slow immersive rhythm; product density appears only after the ritual/world is established.
records.cta_choreography: Commerce is downstream of a sensory and philosophical frame.
records.trust_proof_placement: Ingredient/ritual specificity grounds otherwise atmospheric wellness language.
records.desktop_to_mobile_transformation: Mobile must preserve material crops and slow pacing, not compress into product tiles.
records.distinctive_authored_mechanisms: Ritual is used as section topology and decision logic.
records.template_like_vs_custom_signals: CUSTOM: sensory/material grammar is coherent enough to distinguish from generic beige wellness.

records.name: Figure 1 Beauty
records.hero_grammar: Science-backed skincare hero combines emotional self-regard with chemistry credibility.
records.media_strategy_crop_negative_space: Skin/product media supports both person-centered identity and formulation evidence.
records.typography_hierarchy: Confident editorial headlines with precise science/product subhierarchy.
records.color_topology: Multi-color controlled brand system rather than clinical monochrome.
records.density_whitespace_rhythm: Balanced rhythm between emotional brand statements and evidence/product sections.
records.module_composition_grammar: human premise → chemistry/science → product approach → results/use → commerce
records.cta_choreography: Purchase is supported by science and identity rather than discount pressure.
records.trust_proof_placement: Science-backed formulation language is placed near product decisions.
records.desktop_to_mobile_transformation: Mobile should preserve contrast between human/emotional scenes and science blocks.
records.distinctive_authored_mechanisms: Refuses problem-shaming while still using clinical authority.
records.template_like_vs_custom_signals: CUSTOM-LEANING: tone and science/human balance are structurally linked.
